replace_files.name: control
replace_files.reason: The plugin contains a Go ELF test server compiled from shipped source, so its binary package must be Architecture:any. Static-Built-Using records the exact Go runtime source package/version.

replace_files.name: rules
replace_files.reason: Keep compiling the supplied Go source, disable implicit toolchain/module downloads, and record exact standard-library source provenance. A single-path static-link exception is intentional because Tempest uploads this helper into guest images including CirrOS; dynamically linking Ubuntu libc would break portability. All other Lintian errors remain enabled.
